PLAN "12-Week Plant-Powered Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain with 150g plant protein daily"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Accumulation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x1 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Intensification" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 65m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hack_squat 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 65m "Upper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x15..20 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Peak Volume and Deload" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x15..20 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 70m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 4x12..15 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 4x10..12 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 70m "Upper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          pec_deck 3x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x15..20 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
          concentration_curl 3x10..12 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 4x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x15..20 rpe 9 rest 45 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x1 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

goals.name: Muscle gain with 150g plant protein daily
